critical_test_gaps.name: Order State Machine Transitions
critical_test_gaps.description: The StateMachine struct has CanTransition, GetValidTransitions, and Transition methods that are completely untested. These enforce the core order lifecycle. Invalid transitions (e.g., pending->shipped, cancelled->paid) must be rejected.
critical_test_gaps.risk: Invalid state transitions could allow orders to skip payment, skip shipping, etc.

critical_test_gaps.name: Cart-to-Checkout-to-Order Integration Flow
critical_test_gaps.description: No integration test exists for the full flow: cart -> checkout -> reserve inventory -> process payment -> create order -> confirm. This is the most critical business flow.
critical_test_gaps.risk: End-to-end checkout failures would directly impact revenue.

critical_test_gaps.name: Inventory Reserve -> Release -> Confirm Flow
critical_test_gaps.description: No integration test for the full inventory lifecycle: reserve stock on checkout, release on failure, confirm on payment.

critical_test_gaps.name: Payment State Machine Transitions
critical_test_gaps.description: Payment.TransitionTo() is untested. Must verify all valid and invalid transitions.

critical_test_gaps.name: Checkout State Machine
critical_test_gaps.description: Checkout has a complex state machine (pending->validating->pricing_frozen->reserving->reserved->processing->completed/failed->rolling_back->rolled_back) with no transition validation or tests.
critical_test_gaps.risk: Checkout stuck in invalid states, inventory never released.

critical_test_gaps.name: Cart Merge Flow
critical_test_gaps.description: Cart merge (guest-to-user) has domain types but no tests for the merge logic.

critical_test_gaps.name: Order Number Generator Uniqueness
critical_test_gaps.description: OrderNumberGenerator.Generate() uses timestamp+sequence+random. No tests verify uniqueness under concurrency.

critical_test_gaps.name: Snapshot Integrity
critical_test_gaps.description: OrderSnapshot has checksum verification but no tests for tamper detection or corruption scenarios.
critical_test_gaps.risk: Undetected data corruption in order snapshots.
